items.title: COLUMN: College football ticket prices leave fans out
items.summary:
College football is at its best when loyal fans create a loud crowd and pack into a sold-out stadium.

But it's getting harder than ever for fans to get their hands on tickets.

College football's top games are becoming too expensive for the sport's most loyal fans. As demand for marquee matchups grows, the high prices force fans to watch from outside the stadium.
